provenance: Derived from pot_all failures where the output contained the wrong answer shape for trend/statistical questions.

semantic_labels.label: output.answer_type_gate
semantic_labels.description: Choose answer shape from the question: number, entity, trend label, boolean, or concise phrase.

scope.observed_error: answer included extra fields or a trend label when the gold answer expected only a number/entity

payload.content: Before printing, decide the requested answer type from the question. If it asks for a number, print only the number; if it asks for an entity, print only the entity name; if it asks for a trend, print only the trend label unless the question explicitly asks for a forecast value too.

rationale: Targets trend/statistical failures such as printing `Increasing trend, 49.95` when the requested answer is only the forecast value.
